description: This file defines a custom exception class `ConnectionSignalIdEnforcementFailedException` used to represent a specific error related to enforcement failure when handling Signal IDs in the Eclipse Ditto connectivity model. It includes methods for building instances, creating from messages or JSON, and manages exception metadata such as error code, message, and HTTP status.

classes.name: ConnectionSignalIdEnforcementFailedException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception thrown when the enforcement of a Signal ID fails within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity framework.

classes.name: ConnectionSignalIdEnforcementFailedException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of `ConnectionSignalIdEnforcementFailedException` with a fluent API.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an exception instance with a specific message and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with the specified headers.
